wallet.note: Neutral Latin American usage. Not monedero or cartera, which read as Spain or as a leather wallet.

hardware wallet.note: Add (hardware wallet) in parentheses on first use in a page.

fee.note: Not tarifa, which reads as a fixed price list.

merchant.note: The business. A person who sells is vendedor.

peer-to-peer electronic cash.note: The whitepaper's phrase. Cash is efectivo throughout, never cash.

Self-custody.note: On first use in a page, gloss it: autocustodia (tú guardas tus propias claves).

custodial.note: Not custodial, which is not Spanish.

Seed phrase.note: The term wallets in Spanish show. Frase de recuperación is fine as a second mention.

Satoshi.note: The unit stays satoshi, lowercase, plural satoshis. Satoshi Nakamoto keeps the capital.

Dust.note: Add (dust) in parentheses on first use in a page.

Mempool.note: Kept in English, feminine: la mempool.

0-conf.note: Kept. Gloss on first use: transacción sin confirmar.

DSProof.note: A protocol name; gloss as prueba de doble gasto.

Halving.note: Kept in English, masculine: el halving. It is the term the Spanish-language crypto press uses.

Opcode.note: Kept in English; gloss as código de operación on first use.

Covenant.note: Kept in English: no Spanish term is in use. Gloss on first use: un contrato que limita cómo se pueden gastar las monedas.

Sighash.note: Kept; it is a field name.

BigInt.note: Kept; gloss as aritmética de alta precisión.

NFT commitment.note: The commitment field; el NFT is masculine.

hard fork.note: Kept, masculine: el hard fork. Bifurcación alone means any fork.

Chipnet.note: A network name; gloss as la red de pruebas de los CHIPs.

SPV.note: Kept; gloss as verificación simplificada de pagos.

blockchain.note: Kept, feminine: la blockchain. Cadena de bloques is fine as a gloss on first use.

hashrate.note: Hashrate in parentheses on first use.

exchange.note: Kept, masculine: el exchange. It is what Latin American users call a trading platform; casa de cambio means a currency booth.

stablecoin.note: Kept, feminine: la stablecoin. Gloss as moneda estable on first use.

whitepaper.note: Kept for Satoshi's paper (el whitepaper de Bitcoin). Libro blanco reads as a government report.

Get a Wallet.note: Menu items and buttons take the infinitive (style guide, Register).

Honest Risks.note: Riesgos honestos is a literal calque; sin rodeos carries the plain-talk tone.

Support.note: The page is help and community, not donations. Soporte reads as a vendor help desk.
